body_lead: NEW DELHI: Prime Minister Narendra Modi today inaugurated the Vidya Samiksha Kendra (VSK) in Maharashtra, a key initiative aimed at revolutionising education through data-driven governance. Building on the success of the first VSK in Gujarat, this new centre in Pune underscores the Prime Minister's vision of expanding this model nationwide. The Vidya Samiksha Kendras harness advanced technology and AI to monitor academic and administrative performance in real-time.
